mechanics.claim: The burst can bloom again up to 2 times per cast if it kills an enemy or hits a champion or large monster, dealing subsequent damage each time.
mechanics.quote: If the burst kills an enemy or hits a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, the seed blooms after {{fd|0.75}} seconds to burst again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks one instance of damage but does not prevent subsequent blooms.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} blocks an instance of damage but does not prevent subsequent ''Blooms''.

mechanics.claim: Each bloom deals bonus damage against monsters.
mechanics.quote: Each bloom deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
